description_en: The Lākhe community of Pimbāhāḥ worships the goddess as their lineage deity and maintain theguṭhī. The rectangular ground floor of the temple is divided into three parts. The central part (which is solid) has a relief niche with two oval openings, framed by architectural colonnades and an arched tympanum. This is covered in carved metal sheets and represents the main deity of the temple. Two smaller sanctums flank the main sanctum; the one to the right houses Gaṇeśa, while the one to the left is empty. According to legend, this sanctum was kept intentionally empty by Gayaḥ Juju of Sulima (a renowned tantric) and served as a space for him to attain accomplishment. The colonnaded front portion of the temple has three bays, and each bay has a highly carved tympanon. Both the timber posts and the tympanon are clad in carved metal sheets. The plinth extends to the front, and has bells and guardian animals on either sides. The two lower roofs of the temple are roofed with terracotta tiles while the topmost roof is finished in flat metal sheets and crowned with a triple pinnacle. Aphalcā(LAL4217) in front of the temple is used to sing hymns and prayers to the goddess. Other smaller shrines are scattered around the temple.A legend that connects Caṇḍeśvarī to the same goddess of Banepa is popular among the people of Patan. According to the legend, Caṇḍeśvarī once came from Banepa to Patan to watch the Matsyendranātha's chariot procession. Gayaḥ Juju, a Tantra practitioner, used his power to keep her in Patan and placed her in this temple.The 2015 earthquakes caused heavy damage including major cracks in the walls. Local residents completely restored the temple.
description_ne: पिम्बहाः पोखरीको उत्तरमा यो तीनछाने मन्दिर अवस्थित छ । मन्दिरको बाहिरी ढोकाबाट प्रवेश गर्दा मन्दिरको गर्भगृहमा नभई बाहिरै तीन वटा कवल र बीचको कवलको सामुन्ने दुईवटा तोरणमुनि चण्डेश्वरीका रूपमा पूजिने खोपीहरू देखिन्छन् । अन्य दुई कवलको बीचमा पनि त्यस्ता खोपीहरू छन् । तीनैवटा कवलको पित्तलले मोडिएको स्तम्भमाथि पित्तलका तोरण चढाइएका छन् । मन्दिरको दाहिनेपट्टि भागमा साँघुरो प्रवेशमार्गबाट मन्दिरभित्र पस्दा पित्तलको तोरणमुनिको प्रतिमास्थानमा गणेशको अमूर्त प्रतिमा देखिन्छ । यो प्रतिमाको सीधा अगाडि ढोका बाहिर नन्दिको मूर्ति राखिएको छ । मन्दिरको दायाँ र बायाँ गरी दुईवटा घण्टाहरू पनि रहेका छन् ।  तीनतले मन्दिरका टुँडालहरूमा शक्ति सहितका भैरवका, गणेश, नृत्येश्वर लगायत शाक्त सम्प्रदायका देवताहरूको मूर्ति कुँदिएका छन् र घण्टाको बाहिरपट्टि मन्दिरको दुई छेउमा सिंहका मूर्ति छन्।  मन्दिरको पहिलो छानाको फेदमा छत्र सहितको गजुर राखिएको छ, दोस्रो छानाको फेदमा पनि गजुर राखिएको छ, अनि तेस्रो छानामाथि सुनको मोलम्बा लगाइएको तीनवटा गजुर, छत्र र ध्वजाहरू रहेका छन् । गजुरबाट तोरण अगाडिसम्म आइपुग्ने गरी पताःहरू लट्काइएका छन् ।यस चण्डेश्वरीलाई पिम्बहालका लाखे खलकहरूले आफ्नो कुलदेवताका रूपमा पुज्ने गर्दछन् । सोही लाखे खलकद्वारा संचालित एक गुठी पनि अस्तित्वमा छ । मत्स्येन्द्रनाथको रथजात्रा हेर्न आएकी बनेपाकी चण्डेश्वरी देवीलाई पाटन सुलिमटोलका गयःजुजु नामक तान्त्रिकले आफ्नो तन्त्रशक्ति प्रयोग गरी यसै स्थानमा रोकेर यो मन्दिर स्थापना गरी राखे भन्ने लोकोक्ति पाटनमा प्रचलित छ ।

historical_events.event_description: Mālasĩha Bhavo and other Bhavos donated a a lion statue.
Sundara Bahādura and his wife Beljima donated a brasstoraṇa.
Garuḍa Nārāyaṇa Śresṭha, Siddhi Kumārī Śresṭha and other family members offered a copperpatāḥto Caṇḍeśvarī.
Dhanalakṣmī and Bhājudeva Bhāro repaired the temple and donated ajaḥrũhiti.
Govinda Siṃha offered an embossed brass lion throne to Caṇḍeśvarī.

historical_events.event_name: Covering of upper roof with copper
historical_events.event_description: Harṣa Narasiṃ, his son Harṣa Nārāsiṃ, and some of his other family members covered the upper roof with copper plates. The embossed copper eaves board was also added at this time.
Nhuchẽlāla and Dhanamāyā from Chābāhāḥṭoladonated a copperpatāḥ.
